info.title: Ringg AI API Documentation
info.description: This is the documentation for the Ringg AI APIs. The Ringg AI API follows RESTful principles, making it intuitive and easy to integrate with your applications. All API requests should be made to the base URL. The API accepts and returns data in JSON format. Ensure your requests include the appropriate Content-Type header for POST and PATCH requests.

post.description: Creates a new Ringg Space under the primary workspace that owns the API key. The Ringg Space is a full workspace (own agents, numbers, campaigns, call history, members) that starts with zero balance or credit limit and zero concurrency; allocate to it afterwards. Every member of the primary is given inherited access to it. The first Ringg Space turns the primary into a family in individual billing mode.

parameters.description: (Required) The API key of the PRIMARY workspace. A Ringg Space's own key is refused (403, or 400 if Ringg Spaces are enabled on it).

name.description: (Required) Display name of the new Ringg Space, 1-100 characters. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

200.description: Successful Response: The new Ringg Space.

400.description: Bad Request - The name is blank, or the API key belongs to a Ringg Space that has Ringg Spaces enabled (no nesting).

message.example: Sub-workspaces cannot have their own sub-workspaces.

patch.summary: Allocate Concurrency to a Ringg Space

metadata.og:title: Allocate Concurrency to a Ringg Space | Ringg AI

patch.description: Sets how many concurrent calls one Ringg Space may run, taken from the family's capacity (bought on the primary). Allocations across all Ringg Spaces cannot exceed the capacity. In an individual-billing family the allocation is also the Ringg Space's hard ceiling; in a common-billing family the ceiling is the family total, so idle capacity flows to whichever Ringg Space is busy.

parameters.name: X-API-KEY
parameters.description: (Required) The API key of the PRIMARY workspace. A Ringg Space's own key is refused (403, or 400 if Ringg Spaces are enabled on it).

concurrency.description: (Required) Concurrent calls to allocate to this Ringg Space. 0 stops it from calling.

200.description: Successful Response: The new allocation and the family totals.

message.example: Mumbai Collections now has 20 concurrent calls

limit_concurrency.description: The persisted ceiling: equals concurrency in an individual-billing family, the family total in a common-billing family.

allocated_total.description: Sum of all Ringg Space allocations after this change.

example.message: Mumbai Collections now has 20 concurrent calls

400.description: Bad Request - The allocation does not fit the family's capacity.

message.example: Only 30 concurrent calls are available to allocate from the parent workspace (capacity 50, 20 already allocated to other sub-workspaces).

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key.

403.description: Forbidden - Ringg Spaces are not enabled for this workspace (also what a Ringg Space's own key gets), or the caller is not an active member of the primary.

message.example: Sub-workspaces are not enabled for this workspace.

404.description: Not Found - No active Ringg Space with this id under the primary.

500.description: Internal Server Error - Something went wrong on our end.

message.example: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.

patch.description: Postpaid, individual-billing families only. Sets every active Ringg Space's credit limit in one call and optionally the family total. The map must name every active Ringg Space exactly once; a slice cannot drop below what that Ringg Space has already used this month, the slices cannot exceed the family total, and what remains for the primary must cover its own usage. Not applicable to common-billing families, where credit is pooled on the primary.

parameters.name: X-API-KEY
parameters.description: (Required) The API key of the PRIMARY workspace. A Ringg Space's own key is refused (403, or 400 if Ringg Spaces are enabled on it).

allocations.description: (Required) sub_workspace_id -> new credit limit. Must include every active Ringg Space exactly once. Values >= 0, two decimals. Values may be JSON numbers (`200000`) or numeric strings (`"200000.00"`).

parent_credit_limit.description: (Optional) New family total (the primary's credit limit). Omit to keep the current total. A JSON number or a numeric string, >= 0.

200.description: Successful Response: The applied limits. Amounts are decimal strings.

parent_credit_limit.description: The family total, as a decimal string.

400.description: Bad Request - Wrong billing mode, an incomplete map, or an allocation the family cannot cover.

message.example: This family uses common billing; per-sub credit limits do not exist.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key.

403.description: Forbidden - Ringg Spaces are not enabled for this workspace (also what a Ringg Space's own key gets), or the caller is not an active member of the primary.

message.example: Sub-workspaces are not enabled for this workspace.

404.description: Not Found - The primary has no Ringg Spaces yet.

message.example: Workspace is not a sub-workspace family parent.

500.description: Internal Server Error - Something went wrong on our end.

message.example: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.

patch.description: Prepaid, individual-billing families only. Sets every active Ringg Space's wallet to an absolute balance; the net difference moves from or to the primary's unallocated pot, which must be able to cover it. Top up on the primary first, then allocate. Not applicable to common-billing families, where the wallet is shared on the primary.

parameters.name: X-API-KEY
parameters.description: (Required) The API key of the PRIMARY workspace. A Ringg Space's own key is refused (403, or 400 if Ringg Spaces are enabled on it).

allocations.description: (Required) sub_workspace_id -> the Ringg Space's NEW absolute balance (not a delta). Must include every active Ringg Space exactly once. Values >= 0, two decimals. Values may be JSON numbers (`200000`) or numeric strings (`"200000.00"`).

200.description: Successful Response: The applied balances. Amounts are decimal strings.

parent_available_balance.description: The primary's unallocated pot after the move, as a decimal string.

400.description: Bad Request - Wrong billing mode, an incomplete map, or more than the primary's pot can cover.

message.example: These allocations need 9000.00 from the primary's pot, which only holds 4000.00. Lower the allocations or add balance to the primary workspace first.

patch.description: Updates one setting of an existing agent per request. Each operation requires specific fields. Without `version_id`, the change applies to the agent's active version.

operation.description: The setting to change. Each operation reads only its own fields; see the field descriptions.

version_id.description: (Optional) Agent version to change. Without it, the active version is changed; when an A/B test is live, the most recently updated version. Must belong to the agent, or the request returns 404.

language.description: Used with `edit_voice`: the voice's language. The voice must support it.

secondary_voice_id.description: Used with `edit_voice`: a second voice. Send an empty string to remove it.

oneOf.example: You are a helpful sales assistant.

agent_prompt.description: Used with `edit_prompt`. Replaces the whole prompt: send every section, because a section you leave out is deleted. Variables are written `@{{name}}` or `{{name}}`.

custom_variables.description: Used with `edit_custom_vars`. Replaces the whole list. An outbound agent must keep `callee_name` and `mobile_number`, or the request returns 403.

whitelisted_domains.description: Used with `edit_agent_whitelisted_domains`. Replaces the list; it must keep `https://www.ringg.ai`.

chat_settings.description: Used with `operation: "edit_chat_settings"`. `whatsapp_session` sets how long a WhatsApp agent's chats stay open. Fields you leave out keep their current values.

whatsapp_session.description: WhatsApp chat session timeouts. Send both fields: one you leave out is reset to its default. The maximum length must be at least the idle timeout. Applies to chats that open after the change.

idle_timeout_minutes.description: End the chat after this many minutes with no message from the customer.

max_duration_minutes.description: Start a new chat once a chat is this many minutes old.

event_subscriptions.description: Used with `operation: "edit_event_subscriptions"`. The agent's complete list of webhook subscriptions. The list you send replaces the existing one, so include every subscription you want to keep.

event_type.description: Events delivered to this callback URL. An event type can have up to 4 subscriptions on one agent. `call_started`, `call_ringing`, `call_ongoing`, `call_completed` and `recording_completed` apply to voice agents and `chat_completed` to WhatsApp agents; subscribing an agent to an event its channel never sends returns 400.

callback_url.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives the events.

method_type.description: HTTP method Ringg uses when calling your endpoint.

headers.description: Headers Ringg sends to your endpoint with every event, for example a token your receiver checks.

intro_message.description: Used with `edit_intro_message`: the first message. Replaces the current one.
intro_message.example: Hello, this is Asha from Acme Lending.

mute_during_intro.description: Used with `edit_noise_settings` (required there): `true` stops the caller interrupting the first message.

mute_while_bot_speaking.description: Used with `edit_noise_settings` (required there): `true` stops the caller interrupting the agent at any time.

vocab.description: Used with `edit_vocab`: words the agent should recognise. Replaces the list; at most 100 words in total.

pre_query_response_phrases.description: Used with `edit_query_phrases`: phrases the agent may say while it looks something up. Replaces the list.

pre_query_phrase_probability.description: Used with `edit_query_phrases` (optional): how often a phrase is said, from 0 to 1.

vad_settings.description: Used with `edit_vad_settings`. Replaces the current settings.

call_config.description: Used with `edit_call_config`. Merged into the agent's call settings: only the keys you send change, and nested objects such as `voicemail` merge key by key. Takes the same keys as `call_config` on Create Agent, such as `call_time`, `max_call_length`, `idle_timeout_warning`, `idle_timeout_end` and `voicemail`. `idle_timeout_warning` must stay below `idle_timeout_end`.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid parameters or request format.

message.example: Selected voice does not support the specified language

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key.

403.description: Forbidden - For example, `edit_custom_vars` without `callee_name` or `mobile_number` on an outbound agent.

message.example: These variables cannot be removed: callee_name, mobile_number

404.description: Not Found - Agent or agent version not found.

422.description: Validation Error - An unknown operation, or a field missing or of the wrong type for the operation.

500.description: Internal Server Error - Something went wrong on our end.

post.description: Starts one outbound call to a recipient. Send `from_number_id` or `from_number` as the caller number, not both. Both may be left out when the agent version has its own outbound numbers; those numbers also take precedence over the request's caller number.

name.description: The name of the person to call

mobile_number.description: The phone number to call (must include country code, e.g., +91 for India)

agent_id.description: UUID of the agent that will handle the call

from_number.description: Caller phone number, or array of caller phone numbers, with country code. Send either `from_number` or `from_number_id`, not both (422).

custom_args_values.description: Custom variables that will be replaced in the agent's prompt using @{{variable_name}} syntax

smart_formatter.description: (Optional) Smart formatting for callee name — supports first name extraction and dictionary-based transliteration

extract_first_name.description: Extract the first actual name from the full name, skipping common prefixes (Mr, Mrs, Dr, etc.)

transliteration.description: Transliterate the extracted name to the target language using a local dictionary. When enabled, extract_first_name is automatically applied.

retry_not_picked.description: Minutes to wait if not picked (default: 30)

scheduled_at.description: Schedule the call: a local date and time without an offset, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`, read in `timezone` (the agent's timezone when `timezone` is not sent). It must be in the future. A time outside `call_start_time`–`call_end_time` moves to the next opening.

from_number_id.description: Workspace number ID, or array of workspace number IDs, from List workspace numbers. Send either `from_number_id` or `from_number`, not both (422).

version_id.description: Optional agent version ID. Defaults to the active version.

call_category.description: Optional category for internal reporting or workflow grouping.

parent_call_id.description: Optional parent call ID for follow-up or chained-call flows.

purpose.description: Send `transactional` so the workspace and agent [call limits](/documentation/manage-account/call-limits) do not apply to this call. Leave it out for other calls.

call_validity_hours.description: Hours the call may wait before it is cancelled with sub-status `DEADLINE_PASSED`, counted from when the call is created, or from `call_config.call_time.scheduled_at` when it is scheduled. When both this and `call_deadline` are sent, the earlier one applies. A call held by a call limit waits until its deadline; a call with no deadline is cancelled when a limit blocks it (`FREQUENCY_CAPPED`).

call_deadline.description: Latest time the call may be placed. After it the call is cancelled with sub-status `DEADLINE_PASSED`. See `call_validity_hours`.

200.description: Successful Response: Details about the initiated call.

call_status.description: The current status of the call

custom_args_values.description: Custom variables passed in the request

400.description: Bad Request - For example, no caller number and no outbound numbers on the agent version, a Ringg test number used as the caller number, a DND number, or a missing variable.

message.example: Either from_number_id or from_number must be provided, or configure default outbound numbers on the agent version

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key.

402.description: Payment Required - The workspace balance (or available credit limit) does not cover the call.

message.example: Your current balance is insufficient to initiate this call!

422.description: Validation Error - A field is missing or has the wrong type, or both `from_number_id` and `from_number` were sent.

message.example: Provide either from_number_id or from_number, not both

500.description: Internal Server Error - Something went wrong on our end.

message.example: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.

metadata.og:title: Initiate Individual Call (Number Pool) | Ringg AI

post.description: Starts one outbound call to a recipient using a number pool or an explicit caller number. Send at least one of `number_pool_id`, `from_number_id` or `from_number`. With a pool, Ringg picks the caller number from it and ignores the other two.

name.description: The name of the person to call.

mobile_number.description: The phone number to call (must include country code).

agent_id.description: UUID of the agent that will handle the call.

number_pool_id.description: Number pool ID. Ringg picks the caller number from the pool, rotating numbers and skipping ones flagged as spam. When it is sent, `from_number_id` and `from_number` are ignored.

from_number_id.description: Workspace number ID, or array of workspace number IDs. Used when no `number_pool_id` is sent. Send either `from_number_id` or `from_number`, not both (422).

from_number.description: Caller phone number, or array of caller phone numbers, with country code. Used when no `number_pool_id` is sent. Send either `from_number` or `from_number_id`, not both (422).

custom_args_values.description: Custom variables replaced in the agent's prompt using @{{variable_name}} syntax.

smart_formatter.description: (Optional) Smart formatting for callee name — supports first name extraction and transliteration.

extract_first_name.description: Extract the first actual name from the full name, skipping common prefixes (Mr, Mrs, Dr, etc.).

transliteration.description: Transliterate the extracted name using a local dictionary. Automatically applies extract_first_name.

scheduled_at.description: Schedule the call: a local date and time without an offset, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`, read in `timezone` (the agent's timezone when `timezone` is not sent). It must be in the future. A time outside `call_start_time`–`call_end_time` moves to the next opening.

voice_id.description: Optional AgentVoice ID for this call. Overrides the agent version's default voice.

version_id.description: Optional agent version ID. Defaults to the active version.

call_category.description: Optional category for internal reporting or workflow grouping.

parent_call_id.description: Optional parent call ID for follow-up or chained-call flows.

purpose.description: Send `transactional` so the workspace and agent [call limits](/documentation/manage-account/call-limits) do not apply to this call. Leave it out for other calls.

call_validity_hours.description: Hours the call may wait before it is cancelled with sub-status `DEADLINE_PASSED`, counted from when the call is created, or from `call_config.call_time.scheduled_at` when it is scheduled. When both this and `call_deadline` are sent, the earlier one applies. A call held by a call limit waits until its deadline; a call with no deadline is cancelled when a limit blocks it (`FREQUENCY_CAPPED`).

call_deadline.description: Latest time the call may be placed. After it the call is cancelled with sub-status `DEADLINE_PASSED`. See `call_validity_hours`.

schema.description: Send at least one of `number_pool_id`, `from_number_id` or `from_number`. `from_number_id` and `from_number` cannot both be set. When `number_pool_id` is sent, the pool wins.

200.description: Successful Response: Details about the initiated call.

400.description: Bad Request - For example, the pool does not exist or has no usable number, or a Ringg test number was used as the caller number.

message.example: Number pool has no available numbers

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key.

402.description: Payment Required - The workspace balance (or available credit limit) does not cover the call.

message.example: Your current balance is insufficient to initiate this call!

422.description: Validation Error - No caller number source, both `from_number_id` and `from_number`, an empty `number_pool_id`, or a field with the wrong type.

message.example: Provide at least one of: number_pool_id, from_number_id, from_number

500.description: Internal Server Error.

message.example: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.

post.description: Creates a new AI agent with the specified configuration. The agent will be created with a single prompt-based flow.

introduction_and_objective.description: (Required) Introduction and objective of the agent
introduction_and_objective.example: You are a customer support agent for Acme Corp.

response_guidelines.description: (Required) Guidelines for how the agent should respond
response_guidelines.example: Be polite, helpful, and concise. Always confirm understanding.

task.description: (Required) The task the agent should perform
task.example: Help customers with their orders and answer product questions.

faq.example: Q: What are your hours? A: We are open 9am-6pm IST.

sample_conversations.description: (Optional) Example conversations for the agent. Use \n for newlines between turns.
sample_conversations.example:
User: Hi
Agent: Hello! How can I help you today?

primary_language.description: (Required) Primary language locale for the agent

secondary_language.description: (Optional) Secondary language locale for the agent

voice_id.description: (Required) Voice ID (UUID). Get available voices from the List Voices endpoint.

intro_message.description: (Required) Introduction message the agent will speak when the call starts
intro_message.example: Hello, this is Sarah from Acme Corp. How can I assist you today?

agent_type.description: (Required) Type of agent. Defaults to outbound.

custom_variables.description: (Optional) Custom variables for the agent. For outbound agents, callee_name and mobile_number are always included automatically.

call_config.description: (Optional) Call behaviour for the agent. Every field is optional — omit the block, or any key in it, to accept the default. These are the same keys the settings are stored under, so what you send here is what the agent runs with.

call_time.description: Daily window the agent may place calls in. Outside it an outbound call is not dialled immediately, and retries are pushed to the next opening. Applies to the agent's own calls; a campaign or an individual call can override it.

call_start_time.description: Earliest local time the agent may dial, 'HH:MM' 24-hour (default: 09:00).

call_end_time.description: Latest local time the agent may dial, 'HH:MM' 24-hour. The window may cross midnight (e.g. 22:00-06:00) (default: 21:00).

timezone.description: IANA timezone the window is expressed in. **Any IANA zone is supported**, not just India - e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Dubai, Asia/Riyadh, Australia/Sydney, UTC. Always use the full Region/City form: 'IST'/'PST' are rejected outright, while 'EST'/'MST'/'GMT' are accepted but are fixed-offset zones that never observe daylight saving (an agent on 'EST' runs an hour behind New York for most of the year) (default: Asia/Kolkata).

max_call_length.description: Hard cap on call duration in seconds (default: 240).

idle_timeout_warning.description: Seconds of caller silence before the agent checks in (“Are you still there?”). Must be less than idle_timeout_end; use 0 to disable the check-in (default: 5).

idle_timeout_end.description: Seconds of caller silence before the call is dropped. Must be greater than idle_timeout_warning (default: 10).

noise_filter_config.description: Background-noise cancellation applied to the caller's audio.

detect.description: Detect that the call reached a voicemail (default: true).

action.description: What the agent does once it detects a voicemail: hang up, leave a generated summary, or speak static_message (default: end).

retry.description: Re-queue the call for a later attempt after hitting voicemail (default: true).

static_message.description: Spoken verbatim when action is static_message. Ignored otherwise.
static_message.example: Sorry we missed you, please call us back.

background_audio_config.description: Ambient audio mixed under the agent's speech. Omit the whole object to keep background audio off.

audio_id.description: (Required within this object) Track to play. office_ambience is the only track available.

volume.description: Playback level as a fraction between 0.0 and 1.0 — not a percentage (default: 0.5).

mixing.description: Mix the track under the agent's speech (default: true).

loop.description: Repeat the track for the whole call (default: true).

mute_during_intro.description: When true the caller cannot interrupt the intro message — the agent finishes speaking it before it starts listening. Set false to make the first message interruptible (default: true).

version.description: The version slug of the agent

from_numbers.description: Caller numbers, as workspace number IDs from List workspace numbers (recommended) or as numbers written exactly as listed there. Send exactly one of `from_numbers` or `number_pool_id`. A number that is not in the workspace makes the campaign `failed` after launch.

number_pool_id.description: Number pool ID. Ringg picks caller numbers from the pool, rotating numbers and skipping ones flagged as spam. Send exactly one of `from_numbers` or `number_pool_id`.

call_retry_config.description: Retries for unanswered, busy and failed calls. Without it the campaign makes no retries.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime for scheduled call (e.g. '2026-10-18T09:00:00'). Uses the timezone above.

concurrency_percentage.description: This campaign's share, in percent, of the workspace's concurrent calls while several campaigns are ongoing. Campaigns at `0` share what is left equally.

call_slots.description: (Optional) Exact windows the campaign may dial in, in `call_config.call_time.timezone`. `absolute` lists dated intervals (`DD/MM/YYYY, HH:MM`); `weekly` repeats day-of-week windows (`HH:MM`). Each slot is 1 minute to 24 hours, not in the past, and inside the daily `call_time` window; the last must end at least 5 minutes from now. Without `campaign_start_time`/`campaign_end_time`, the campaign runs from the first slot's start to the last slot's end.

until.description: `DD/MM/YYYY, HH:MM`. Windows repeat from `campaign_start_time` (or now) until this time, at most 90 days.

schema.description: Send exactly one of `from_numbers` or `number_pool_id`; both or neither returns 422. `campaign_start_time` and `campaign_end_time` are required unless `call_slots` is sent, and must be sent together.

number_pool.summary: Caller numbers from a number pool

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid input.

message.example: Bulk list is not ready to start.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing authentication.

402.description: Payment Required - The balance (or available credit limit) does not cover the campaign. The campaign is set to `insufficient_balance`; add balance, call Check Campaign Balance, then send this request again.

message.example: Insufficient balance to start this campaign. Please top up and use /check-balance to re-verify.

422.description: Validation Error - Both or neither of `from_numbers` and `number_pool_id`, only one of `campaign_start_time` and `campaign_end_time`, invalid `call_slots`, or a field with the wrong type.

message.example: Provide exactly one of from_numbers / number_pool_id, not both

metadata.og:title: Check Campaign Balance Beta | Ringg AI

post.description: Beta endpoint for re-checking the balance of a campaign in `insufficient_balance` after a top-up. When the balance now covers it, the campaign returns to `draft`; then send /campaign/make-call-async again.

200.description: Balance checked. `status` is `draft` when the campaign can start, or still `insufficient_balance`.

total_callees.description: When `status` is `draft`: valid contacts in the campaign.

required_credits.description: When `status` is `insufficient_balance`: estimated cost of the campaign.

additional_balance_required.description: When `status` is `insufficient_balance`: how much more balance is needed.

value.message: Balance is sufficient. You can now start the campaign via /make-call-async.
Insufficient balance to start this campaign.

400.description: Bad Request - The campaign is not in `insufficient_balance`, has no contacts, or has no agent.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing authentication.
